name: glb-designer-stage3d
description: Asset Studio Stage 3d — sets & modular customization. PART A (configurable product): in the GLB designer, drive a table spec whose 4 round (cylinder) legs and 4 square (box) legs are two separate groups; mark both as options of one 'Legs' variant slot and export as a user configurable product (base + Legs slot, each option a baked data-URL GLB). Open the exported product in the existing ConfiguratorDialog, swap the Legs option from Round → Square (asserting the option renders + is selected), then Save to catalog — asserting the baked user def's slotSpec envelope records the Square option. PART B (sets): drive a 2-group design, tick 'Save groups as separate assets', Save — asserting THREE new defs land (2 single-piece assets named after the groups + 1 combined). Cylinder legs prove the baked-GLB option route preserves shape fidelity the configurator's box-only ConfiguredPart cannot.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); localStorage.removeItem('hdb_user_products') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setUserConfigurableProducts?.([]); s.setQualityTier?.('performance'); })()

steps.name: seed-table-with-leg-variants
steps.comment: Drive the designer to the state a user reaches by building a table, grouping its legs, then duplicating that group and editing the copy into square legs — two leg GROUPS (round cylinders + square boxes) over one shared tabletop.
steps.eval: (function(){ const corners=[[-0.5,-0.3],[0.5,-0.3],[-0.5,0.3],[0.5,0.3]]; const parts=[{id:'top',kind:'box',position:[0,0.74,0],size:[1.2,0.04,0.8],color:'#9a7b50'}]; const round=[]; const square=[]; corners.forEach((c,i)=>{ const rid='rl'+i, sid='sl'+i; parts.push({id:rid,kind:'cylinder',position:[c[0],0.36,c[1]],size:[0.06,0.72,0.06],color:'#8a6a45'}); parts.push({id:sid,kind:'box',position:[c[0],0.36,c[1]],size:[0.06,0.72,0.06],color:'#6e5337'}); round.push(rid); square.push(sid); }); window.__glbDesigner.setSpec({ sourceScale:1, meshOverrides:{}, parts, partGroups:[ {id:'leg-round',name:'Round legs',partIds:round}, {id:'leg-square',name:'Square legs',partIds:square} ] }); })()

steps.name: assert-two-leg-groups
steps.comment: Both leg groups appear as rows in the layers tree; the Make configurable panel is up.
steps.eval: (function(){ const names=[...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer .lyr-nm')].map(n=>(n.textContent||'').trim()); if(names.filter(t=>t==='Round legs').length!==1) throw new Error('Round legs group missing'); if(names.filter(t=>t==='Square legs').length!==1) throw new Error('Square legs group missing'); if(![...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer .sec-h span, .glb-designer summary.compose-summary')].some(s=>(s.textContent||'').trim()==='Make configurable')) throw new Error('Make configurable panel missing'); })()

steps.name: name-the-product
steps.eval: (function(){ const inp=document.querySelector('.glb-designer input[aria-label="Asset name"]'); const setter=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(inp),'value').set; setter.call(inp,'Configurable table'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); })()

steps.name: export-configurable
steps.comment: Mark both leg groups as options of one 'Legs' slot (Round default + Square) and bake → a user configurable product.

steps.name: assert-product-registered
steps.failMessage: exported product should register in userConfigurableProducts with a 2-option 'Legs' slot whose options carry baked data-URL GLBs

steps.name: open-configurator-on-product
steps.comment: Open the existing ConfiguratorDialog seeded on the exported user product (SLOT-204 recipe seed).
steps.eval: (function(){ const st=window.__store.getState(); const p=st.userConfigurableProducts[0]; st.setConfiguratorEditSpec(JSON.stringify({productId:p.id, selections:{}})); st.setConfiguratorOpen(true); })()

steps.name: assert-legs-slot-and-options
steps.comment: The user product is selected; its 'Legs' slot offers Round + Square option buttons.
steps.eval: (function(){ const labels=[...document.querySelectorAll('.configurator-dialog .sec-h span')].map(s=>(s.textContent||'').trim()); if(!labels.includes('Legs')) throw new Error('Legs slot section missing'); const btns=[...document.querySelectorAll('.configurator-dialog button')].map(b=>(b.textContent||'').trim()); if(!btns.some(t=>t.startsWith('Round'))) throw new Error('Round option missing'); if(!btns.some(t=>t.startsWith('Square'))) throw new Error('Square option missing'); })()

steps.name: swap-to-square
steps.comment: Swap the Legs option to Square — the preview re-bakes the square-leg GLB live.
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn=[...document.querySelectorAll('.configurator-dialog button')].find(b=>(b.textContent||'').trim().startsWith('Square')); if(!btn) throw new Error('Square option button missing'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-square-selected
steps.comment: The Square button now reads as the active (accent) selection.
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn=[...document.querySelectorAll('.configurator-dialog button')].find(b=>(b.textContent||'').trim().startsWith('Square')); if(!btn.className.includes('btn-accent')) throw new Error('Square option did not become the active selection'); })()

steps.name: save-configured
steps.comment: Bake the Square configuration into the catalog through the unchanged saveConfiguredAsset path.
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn=[...document.querySelectorAll('.configurator-dialog button')].find(b=>(b.textContent||'').trim()==='Save to catalog'); if(!btn) throw new Error('Save to catalog button missing'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-configured-saved
steps.comment: The baked user def records the Square option in its slotSpec envelope (selections.Legs === 'leg-square').

waitFor.store: state.userFurniture.length > window.__cfgBaseline && state.userFurniture.some(d => typeof d.slotSpec === 'string' && (() => { try { const env = JSON.parse(d.slotSpec); const s = env.payload || env; return !!(s && s.selections && s.selections.Legs === 'leg-square') } catch { return false } })())

steps.failMessage: the saved configured asset should carry a slotSpec selecting the Square leg option (leg-square)

steps.name: seed-two-piece-design
steps.comment: A two-piece design: two separate single-box groups ('Cube A' + 'Cube B').
steps.eval: (function(){ window.__glbDesigner.setSpec({ sourceScale:1, meshOverrides:{}, parts:[ {id:'a',kind:'box',position:[0,0.25,0],size:[0.5,0.5,0.5],color:'#9a7b50'}, {id:'b',kind:'box',position:[1.2,0.25,0],size:[0.5,0.5,0.5],color:'#6e5337'} ], partGroups:[ {id:'gA',name:'Cube A',partIds:['a']}, {id:'gB',name:'Cube B',partIds:['b']} ] }); })()

steps.name: name-the-set
steps.eval: (function(){ const inp=document.querySelector('.glb-designer input[aria-label="Asset name"]'); const setter=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(inp),'value').set; setter.call(inp,'Two Cube Set'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); })()

steps.name: enable-split-groups
steps.comment: Tick 'Save groups as separate assets' (SavePanel switch).
steps.eval: (function(){ const sw=document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Save groups as separate assets"]'); if(!sw) throw new Error('split-groups switch missing'); sw.scrollIntoView(); sw.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-split-on
steps.eval: (function(){ const sw=document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Save groups as separate assets"]'); if(!sw || sw.getAttribute('aria-checked')!=='true') throw new Error('split-groups switch did not turn on'); })()

steps.name: save-set
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn=[...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer button')].find(b=>b.textContent.trim()==='Save asset' && !b.disabled); if(!btn) throw new Error('Save asset button not found or disabled'); btn.scrollIntoView(); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-set-split-into-three
steps.comment: One combined asset ('Two Cube Set') + one single-piece asset per group ('Cube A', 'Cube B') → 3 new defs.

waitFor.store: state.userFurniture.length === window.__setsBaseline + 3 && ['Two Cube Set','Cube A','Cube B'].every(n => state.userFurniture.some(d => d.name === n))

steps.failMessage: saving a 2-group design with split-groups on should add 3 defs: the combined 'Two Cube Set' + single-piece 'Cube A' and 'Cube B'
